:::{#me}

I'm a senior Zoology Major at the University of New Hampshire in Durham, NH, United States. I'm passionate about avian movement ecology, molecular physiology, and evolution. I have experience in passerine banding, CTT tagging, and blood sampling, along with skills in DNA extraction, PCR, and bioinformatics.

I want to investigate the genetics underlying physiological adaptations for long-distance migration and thermoregulation in homeotherms, especially birds.

:::
